title: Industry Pulse — AI / Agent Ecosystem

bullets.title: Two critical unauthenticated PHP RCE flaws (CVE-2026-109618/109619) patched; Finland, BBC, Edinburgh took services offline
bullets.summary: PHP issued patched releases for two critical remote-code-execution bugs affecting any PHP install serving web requests; OpenAI says a researcher found one using GPT-5.6 Sol and Wiz independently found both (per The Neuron digest, primary PHP.net notice linked).
bullets.how: Brand 9 Signs: brand9signs.com runs WordPress on PHP — confirm host (SiteGround) has moved to the patched PHP release today. The Construct: check any PHP-based services on Mac/hosted infra. PRAGMA: timely client-advisory talking point on AI-assisted vuln discovery.

bullets.title: Claude Code 2.1.306–2.1.308 + Claude API version 2026-10-21 (new SDK majors, Apache 2.0)
bullets.summary: 2.1.307 adds /claude-api api-version migration, a claude_code.safety_event OpenTelemetry event per blocked/prompted tool call, and fixes duplicate HTTP MCP tool calls and locked-keychain MCP auth in claude -p; 2.1.306 fixes cloud-session 'Not logged in' for claude -p; 2.1.308 is a reliability release. New API version ships Python SDK 2.0.0, TS 1.0.0 etc. with breaking changes.
bullets.how: The Construct: upgrade Mac runners to 2.1.308 (scheduled claude -p runs benefit from the auth and double-call fixes); pipe safety_event into runner logging; pin SDK versions before accepting the breaking majors. PRAGMA: guardrail observability talking point. Brand 9 Signs: no.

bullets.title: Claude Duet research preview: proactive agent on web, iOS and Android (US Pro/Max waitlist)
bullets.summary: Anthropic opened a waitlist for Duet, a proactive agent that surfaces work needing attention and keeps tasks going after you step away, asking approval before sending messages, paying, signing or deleting; background checks count toward plan limits.
bullets.how: The Construct: direct reference design for approval-gated proactive agents; join the waitlist and compare with our scheduled-routine model. PRAGMA: client-facing example of human-in-the-loop autonomy. Brand 9 Signs: maybe, for order/quote follow-up nudges later.

bullets.title: Claude Security public beta: continuous repo scanning, fix tracking, API and MCP connector
bullets.summary: Claude Security now scans repositories continuously, tracks fixes, builds team-informed threat models, and exposes an API and MCP connector; Enterprise customers get $25k/month free usage credits for two months through Dec 31, 2026.
bullets.how: The Construct: Enterprise-only, but the MCP connector pattern is useful for scanning our hartley-command and runner repos if we reach that tier. PRAGMA: security-review offering for client agent code. Brand 9 Signs: no.

bullets.title: UseIt Studio: design agent that outputs editable manufacturing files (dimensions, bleed, dielines)
bullets.summary: A Product Hunt launch: a design agent that asks follow-up questions and produces editable production-ready files for packaging, stickers and cards (per The Neuron digest; not independently verified).
bullets.how: Brand 9 Signs: watch as a competitor/reference for print-ready file generation, relevant to our logo designer and fabrication-check flow. The Construct: pattern for agents that end in manufacturable output, not mockups. PRAGMA: no.

praxis_lesson: Agent power is increasingly gated by the safety layer around it (approval gates, safety-event telemetry, patch discipline), so log every blocked or prompted action in our runners and treat patching the boring stack (PHP) as agent-era table stakes.
